correctness.rationale: The lumped Markov generator has transitions (0,k)→(0,k-1) at rate k and (0,k)→(1,k) at (k+1)/(m+2), and complementary (1,k) analogues. Positive hub-flip rates make the labeled chain irreducible. Zero net flux across count cuts forces (k+1)a_(k+1)=(m-k)b_k, global complement symmetry b_k=a_(m-k), giving beta-binomial recurrence with alpha=1/(m+3); Vandermonde normalizes each hub mass to 1/2. Factorial moments give E[M]=m/(m+5) and Var[M]=m(m+1)/(2(m+5))−(m/(m+5))². The product form yields uniform P(M=k)=(alpha/k)(1+O(alpha H_m)) and P(M>0)=alpha H_m(1+O(alpha H_m)), hence conditional harmonic law, uniform log M/log m and conditional mean m/log m. I independently implemented rational stationarity and factorial-moment tests m=1..8 and large-m rare-tail diagnostics; finite checks are not substituted for the analytic recursion and uniform product estimates.
